tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database schema with users, notes, study_groups, group_members tables and establish relationships
Implement Node.js/Express backend API with JWT authentication endpoints (register, login, verify email)
Build React authentication UI screens (registration, login) with form validation matching design specs
Configure AWS S3 bucket and implement file upload API endpoints for study notes with metadata storage
Create Notes Library UI with search, filter, and note cards displaying thumbnails, ratings, and download functionality
Develop study group creation and join APIs with group_members relationship management
Build Study Groups UI with discovery, filtering, and group cards matching design specifications
Implement Home Dashboard with quick actions, recent notes, and my groups sections using React components
Add group_messages table and basic messaging API endpoints for group communication
Create note_reviews table and implement rating/review submission and display APIs
Build responsive bottom navigation and ensure mobile-first design across all screens
Implement user profile screen with stats, uploaded notes list, and account settings

risks: AWS S3 configuration and file upload handling may require additional time for proper security and access control setup
Email verification system requires external email service integration which could delay authentication feature completion
Real-time group messaging functionality may need WebSocket implementation adding complexity beyond initial REST API scope
University email validation logic needs clear requirements to prevent unauthorized registrations
File size limits and storage costs for AWS S3 need to be defined to prevent budget overruns during MVP testing
